body:
Genghis Con whats up with that? it was crap there were like three or four tourneys and they all sucked I could have gone to greleey to play the same games but over all I can’t complain cause well I walked away with a foil Maul w/ stick so that ain’t bad at all but the others just sucked.





Tourney #1 sealed Deck Booster draft

Game #1 well thats all there was because I was the only one to show up.



Toueney #2 02/16/02

Game  #1  well as if that wasn’t a crock of @#$%, at first I was the only one to show up, then out of the blue a second player shows up and plays a jank @#$% game the guy I played was a serious jack @#$% poor attitude and just took the fun right out of the game.

Game #2 well I played the same guy and I don’t really want to go into what I just went through in the game abov.



Tourney #3  02/16/02

Game #1 well that was fun I played Fanchi that was a good Game I just had my @#$% handed to me in a lunch box and politely asked to eat my lunch good game though. It was a quick game it went by fast Fanchi and I got into a drain race right away, then he played the gayest part of WYS and retrieved aloy of force then he jsut flat out won the drain race.

Game #2 I played Craig still a good game but things just didn’t add up right and I didn’t have as much fun as I did in the first game.  I just set up and went to town had great fun actually winning for once in a great blue moon.

Game #3 I played Tom M. that was a good game but I once again I lost but thats all good, I only lost by 8 thast kool and that was against a WYS  as well, I just had Loads of fun and well Like I said before I lost.

Game #4 well I played Craig again and Lost and once again I don’t have much fun in this game and we will leave it at that.

Tourney #4

well that wass supposed to be the Team tourney and that didn’t happen I wish it had but it didn’t and well sice I was the on;y one to really be there again I got the trophey that was just handed to someone. Well thats all folks for this tourney report.   Peace out Ed
title: Denver Colorado 02-15-02
author: Edward Rivas
event_desc: the third of the Star Wars CCG tournaments Edward Rivas played at Genghis Con 2002 in Denver, Colorado

games.opponent_objective: Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough
games.note: Drain race; Fanchi retrieved with Watch Your Step and won it.
'actually winning for once in a great blue moon'.

games.opponent_objective: Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough

summary: Edward Rivas played several small Star Wars CCG tournaments at Genghis Con in Denver in February 2002; in the third, on 16 February, he went 1–3, beating Craig once and losing to Fanchi, Tom M. and Craig.
notes: Report covers Rivas's Genghis Con 2002 weekend (title date 02-15-02): Tourney #1, a sealed booster draft, did not happen ('I was the only one to show up'; undated, presumably 15 February); Tourney #2 (16 February) had two players; Tourney #3 (16 February) is the main event here; Tourney #4, a team tournament, 'didn't happen' and Rivas says he was handed the trophy as the only one there. #1 and #4 are not given event pages.

No Genghis Con 2002 events on the List (2001 precedent: '2001 Genghis Con tournament (17 February, evening)'). Two sessions on 16 February, so they are named by Rivas's own numbering: 'tournament 2' and 'tournament 3'.

Main format Premiere - Theed Palace (February 2002 default): two opponents played Watch Your Step (constructed); no Theed card named, though Rivas's prize was 'a foil Maul w/ stick' (Darth Maul With Lightsaber is a Theed Palace card) from an unstated tournament.
'Fanchi' is given by surname only; [[Chris Fanchi]] is a Colorado player with a page, but the full name is not in the report, so not linked. 'Craig' and 'Tom M.' get no pages.
Rivas's decks and sides are not stated; he was Dark in games 1 and 3 (opponents played Watch Your Step, a Light objective); games 2 and 4 sides unknown.
Game 2's result is read as a Win from 'had great fun actually winning for once', although the same lines say the game 'didn't add up right'.
No finish or player counts stated for Tourney #3.
Tourney #2's format is not stated (event_format null).
Reconcile: the two-player "Tourney #2" (no results stated) is not given a page.
